note: Hand-kept (2026-11-09, user: "build folders/guides for my specific characters ... For now we will just work on Arcea"). school_share: the build's damage by spell school, an estimate (Frostbolt and Ice Lance; Arcane Missiles on Missile Barrage). README.md is generated by _reference/data/characters/plan.py arcea. min_levels: an upgrade or enchant is suggested only for an item worn at least this many levels (3 since the user's "replacing items every 2 levels is not ideal", 2026-11-09) (user 2026-11-09: "if I am going to just go and get something that is only going to last one level, then there is no point") min_minutes: and only when it saves this many minutes of killing before the next upgrade replaces it (user 2026-11-09: "I don't want to switch gear if it is only to save me a couple minutes, but saving multiple minutes or hours across the levels until the next upgrade is substantial"; 20 on Claude's recommendation).

checklist_note: The town checklist page (checklist.html, written by plan.py on every run): after each refresh publish it with the Artifact tool to checklist_url (same file path in the same session; from another session pass the url and read it first).
group_note: 2026-11-10, user: "Arcea can do group quest as well. I can group up with random people, as well as do dungeons": elite group quests count as detours (detours.py).

legacy.why: Your main, leveled solo most of the time. Thrill of Adventure first: each point is about 3% less time per kill from the moment you spend it (less drinking and eating). Well Rested is small for a character you play daily, but it is the price of Talented (it needs Well Rested 5/5). Talented gives your talents five levels early: worth a lot at 26, little past 50 and nothing at 60, so it pays only if the points come before about 45. The 16th point goes anywhere (Gourmand). At 60, respec into an endgame build.
legacy.note: user decision 2026-11-10: leveling builds now, respec at 60
